reason: The primary CIF parses and round-trips as a fully occupied, ordered primitive P6/mmm Cr4 cell (a = b = 4.86059167 A, c = 2.30466781 A, Z = 4), with symmetry expansion, composition, multiplicities, and coordinates all consistent. Its nine calculated reflections account for all important observed lines from 5-90 degrees with no extras and a maximum 2theta error of 0.00070 degrees. Crucially, the instantiated coordinates are supported by intensities: independently extracted integrated peak areas agree with the CIF calculation after scale/Debye-Waller fitting at the noise level (chi-square 9.76 for 7 degrees of freedom; intensity correlation 0.9999), rather than merely matching peak positions. Periodic shells have no overlaps (minimum Cr-Cr 2.30467 A), the complete near-neighbor environments and 7.32 g/cm3 density are chemically plausible for elemental Cr, and charge/order/occupancy ambiguities are absent. Alternative indexing cells in the trace were not instantiated as competing structures and provide no concrete surviving incompatible realization; lower-symmetry or supercell alternatives are therefore only hypothetical.
